spans.text: Leader, are you sure it's this way?
The coordinates definitely point towards this place...
Ah, got it! There really are test subjects here... We have to bring them back with us.
Uh... Leader, the radiation levels have been on the rise in this area and the sky is getting dark...
I don't think we can complete this mission on our own.
These test subjects must be very important so we must preserve them.
I've already contacted the Commander. More echelons will be here soon to help us. We just have to hang in there for a while!
Leader, keep an eye on the radiation levels around us.
Even T-Dolls are affected when exposed to extremely high levels of radiation. If a radiation storm spreads towards us, we'll have to move to somewhere safe.
Understood. Let's move it then. Time is short.
